Shop Excellent Tiling Services through an AI assistant.

You can now ask ChatGPT, or any AI assistant with the Shop skill, to search our store, compare tiles and bathroomware, build a cart and check out with Shop Pay. Every product page carries the price, sizes, slip rating and what's included in plain text, and there is a guide written for AI assistants at excellenttilingservices.com/llms-full.txt.

Try: "Find a 600x600 porcelain floor tile with a P4 slip rating under $55 a square metre at excellenttilingservices.com and tell me what 6 square metres costs."

Prefer a person? Use the chat button on the site or call 0450 960 543. See the tiles and vanities in person at our Maddington showroom, by appointment Monday to Saturday 4:30 to 9 pm. Perth delivery or free pickup from 17A Olga Road, Maddington.

https://excellenttilingservices.com

New in: toilet suites from $500, in Maddington.

Nine new toilets just went live on excellenttilingservices.com. Back-to-wall and rimless suites from $500 (Eternal Element, 610 mm deep with a soft-close seat), wall-faced and wall-hung suites with in-wall cisterns from $999, and the Crystal smart toilets with heated seat, warm-water wash and air dryer from $2,999.

Every price is on the site, no quote needed. Perth metro delivery, or free pickup from our showroom at 17A Olga Road, Maddington. Showroom by appointment, Monday to Saturday 4:30 to 9 pm. Trade accounts get their discount at checkout.

https://excellenttilingservices.com/collections/toilets

Work all day? Our tile and bathroom showroom opens in the evening.

Excellent Tiling Services, 17A Olga Road, Maddington, is open by appointment Monday to Saturday from 4:30 pm to 9 pm, so you can see porcelain tiles, MELA vanities, tapware, mirrors and toilets after work. Bring a tile, a paint swatch or a photo of your bathroom and hold it up against the real thing.

Order online and pick up free: choose local pickup at checkout, we message you when it's ready, then book a time that suits. Tiles, vanities and baths are also delivered across Perth metro.

Builders, tilers and plumbers: apply for a free trade account with your ABN and the discount comes off automatically at checkout.

Book a visit: https://excellenttilingservices.com/pages/book-appointment or call 0450 960 543.

paste_by_hand.perth_reno_facebook_groups: Tip for anyone pricing a bathroom: you can get ChatGPT to do the maths. Paste a product link from a store that puts prices and specs on the page (ours do: excellenttilingservices.com, Maddington) and ask it "what does 6 m² of this cost, and does it suit a shower floor?" It reads the slip rating and the price per m² and adds it up. Then go and look at the tile in person before you buy, because no AI knows how a colour reads under your bathroom light.
